lines.name: Montage Plus
lines.description: Welded steel panels on ForeRunner rails. 3/4" pickets with 4" air space (3" on Pet, Pool & Play).

spec.Posts: 2-1/2" sq, 16 ga up to 6'; 14 ga for 7'-8'

lines.name: Echelon Plus
lines.description: Aluminum panels on ForeRunner rails that follow grade. 3- and 4-rail panels, 4" air space.

lines.name: Impasse II
lines.description: Corrugated 2.75" pales, 3.25" pale spacing (1.5" anti-scale), I-beam posts.

lines.name: Legacy

spec.Heights: nominal (Legacy height chart not readable in source)

lines.name: Premier
lines.description: 3/4" pickets on 1.5" x 1" rails, 2.5" posts at 72-1/2" on center.

lines.description: Rounded 1" x 5/8" pickets (formerly Delgard). 3 rails standard, 4 rails at 6'. ~8' sections.

lines.name: Industrial

lines.name: Residential Chain Link
lines.description: 11-1/2 ga fabric on 16 ga posts with a 1-3/8" 17 ga top rail. Color-coated in black, green, brown.

lines.name: Commercial Chain Link (Schedule 40)
lines.material: Schedule 40 galvanized pipe (ASTM F1083), galvanized or color-coated fabric
lines.description: SS40 framework: 2-3/8" line posts, 2-7/8" terminals, 1-5/8" rails. Also PrivaMax/NatureLink privacy options.

lines.name: Security Chain Link
lines.description: Heavy framework with top and bottom rails and three strands of barbed wire on 45 degree arms.

spec.Note: post sizes are a typical security specification

lines.name: Tennis Court Fence
lines.material: Galvanized or black vinyl-coated steel, 1-3/4" mesh
lines.description: 1-3/4" mesh so balls can't wedge in. 3" terminals and 2-1/2" line posts on 10' max spacing; top, middle and bottom rails; optional windscreen.

spec.Post spacing: 10' max; 6' or bigger posts in high wind / with windscreen

lines.name: Basketball Court Fence
lines.description: Court enclosure with 1-3/4" 9 ga mesh, 3-1/2" terminals, 2-1/2" line posts and 1-5/8" top/mid/bottom rails.

spec.Fabric: 9 ga, 1-3/4" mesh (6 ga at hockey goal areas)

lines.name: Ball Stop / Overkick Netting
lines.material: Galvanized steel poles, HDPE or polypropylene netting on steel cable
lines.description: Freestanding netting on cables between poles, for behind goals and over fences. Pole sizes and spacing are nominal: have poles and footings engineered for wind load.

spec.Netting: e.g. 3 mm knotless polypropylene, 100 mm mesh
spec.Pole spacing: about 8 m (26') in a published 6 m system; nominal 20'-25'

lines.name: Cedar Privacy (5/8 x 5-1/2 pickets)

lines.description: Built from stock 5/8" x 5-1/2" dog-ear pickets (Outdoor Essentials, YellaWood and others) on back-mounted 2x4 rails.
